final_report: The patient is elderly (75-79 years) with obesity (BMI 30) and ECOG 1, but exhibits recurrent severe neutropenia (Grade 3) and thrombocytopenia (Grade 3) with incomplete marrow recovery between cycles, indicating cumulative bone marrow toxicity and impaired hematopoietic reserve. Persistent fatigue and alopecia reflect ongoing systemic toxicity. These patterns significantly increase risks of infection and bleeding, portending high mortality risk despite good baseline functional status.
